title: 15-minute signals for KuCoin futures: five order-flow and market-behaviour hypotheses
user_context: The user trades BTC, ETH, BNB, SOL, TRX on KuCoin spot and futures and wants 15-minute signals.
cost_gate_result: KuCoin futures maker 0.02%, taker 0.06%, spreads < 0.012% on BTC/ETH. Holding a single 15m bar with taker orders costs 62-155% of the median move, so trades hold 8 bars (2 hours). Spot is not viable at this horizon.
data: Binance USD-M futures 15m klines with taker-buy volume (public archive), 2022-01..2026-08; prices of these five coins are arbitraged between Binance and KuCoin

trade_mechanics.signal: computed at the close of a 15m bar using only that bar and earlier bars
trade_mechanics.exit: close of the 8th bar held (2 hours), or a protective stop at 3 x ATR(14 bars) touched intrabar (stop fill at the stop, gap fill at the open)
trade_mechanics.one_position_per_coin: a new signal while a trade is open is ignored
trade_mechanics.cost_sensitivity: 0.04% (maker both sides) reported only; maker fills are uncertain until phase 3

definitions.imb4: sum(taker buy volume) / sum(volume) over the last 4 bars
definitions.z(x): (x - mean) / std of the same quantity over the prior 2880 bars (30 days), excluding the current bar
definitions.sigma1: std of 1-bar returns over the prior 2880 bars
definitions.sigma4: std of 4-bar returns over the prior 2880 bars

hypotheses.M1_FLOW_MOMENTUM: z(imb4) > 2 -> long; z(imb4) < -2 -> short (persistent aggressive flow carries information)
hypotheses.M2_ABSORPTION: 4-bar return < -1 sigma4 while z(imb4) > 1.5 -> long; 4-bar return > +1 sigma4 while z(imb4) < -1.5 -> short (passive side absorbing the aggressive side)
hypotheses.M3_CAPITULATION: 1-bar return < -4 sigma1 with volume > 4 x its prior-30-day median -> long; mirror -> short (forced flows overshoot)
hypotheses.M4_BREAKOUT_FLOW: close above the highest high of the prior 96 bars with z(imb4) > 1 -> long; close below the lowest low of the prior 96 bars with z(imb4) < -1 -> short
hypotheses.M5_US_OPEN: on weekdays, at the 14:00 UTC bar close: sign of the return from 13:30 to 14:00 UTC -> same-sign position for 8 bars (US equity open momentum)

statistic: mean net return per trade (%), block bootstrap with 1-day blocks

adopt_rule.discovery: mean > 0, Romano-Wolf p_adj < 0.10 across the 25 tests, at least 100 trades
adopt_rule.validation: mean > 0 and one-sided 90% lower bound > 0, at least 50 trades
adopt_rule.holdout: run once, only for tests that passed both; mean > 0 -> proceeds to the live demo forward test (phase 5); otherwise rejected
adopt_rule.no_pass: if nothing passes, no 15-minute signal is shipped and the user is told

no_changes_after_seeing_results: definitions, parameters, windows, costs and rules above are fixed
